browser.organizationOff: Your organization turned off the browser.
browser.statusUnconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the browser right now. Try again in a moment.
browser.webDisclosure: A browser you and {agent} use together, shown beside the chat. It runs in MindsDB's cloud, so websites see MindsDB's addresses. {agent} asks you before a step that submits, buys, sends or deletes.
browser.desktopDisclosure: A browser inside this app that you and {agent} use together, shown beside the chat. Websites see your own connection, and no MindsDB server carries your browsing. {agent}'s code runs as you and can read this browser's sign-ins. Some sites, Google's sign-in among them, don't allow signing in from an app's built-in browser.
browser.webSignIns: Sites you sign in to stay signed in for your later tasks, in every organization you belong to, until they go 90 days unused or you sign out of all sites in Settings.
browser.desktopSignIns: Sites you sign in to stay signed in on this computer for your later tasks, in every organization of this account, until the site signs you out or you sign out of all sites in Settings. Some sites sign you out when the app quits.
browser.webSignOutHelp: Clears every site's cookies and sign-ins from your browser and from storage. Saved tabs stay.
browser.signOutHelp: Clears this browser's cookies, sign-ins and cache, and closes its tabs. Saved tabs stay.
browser.signOutUnconfirmed: The sign-out didn't confirm in time. It may have finished; sign out again to be sure.
browser.pageContent: {mindshub, select, yes {When {agent} reads a page, its text and a screenshot go to the model provider that serves your turn, MindsHub when you're signed in.} other {When {agent} reads a page, its text and a screenshot go to the model provider that serves your turn.}}
browser.webJevLine: With Fast answers with Jev on, Jev also gets the goal of each browser step, the page's address, title, element names and first 1,500 characters, and the recent steps, earlier addresses included.
browser.usageEventsHelp: {agent} sends MindsDB anonymous usage events, with an installation id, the browser's included, never page text or addresses. Off stops them from the next time you restart the app.
browser.clearFailed: Couldn't clear the browser's data. Try again.
browser.approveStepsHelp: On: {agent} waits for your OK before a step that commits something, like a purchase, a message or a form. Off: {agent} goes ahead with later steps; a step already waiting still asks you.
browser.onlyWhenNeededTitle: Only show the browser when I'm needed
browser.onlyWhenNeededHelp: Turn this off to always see the browser and watch {agent} browse. Fun for some, tedious for others.
browser.onlyWhenNeededLearn: About showing the browser only when needed
browser.decisionsAskAdmin: Ask your admin to set up a decision model to use the browser.
browser.decisionsSetUp: To pick its steps quickly, {agent} needs a decision model. Add its endpoint and API key, then test it.
browser.decisionsRemoved: Off: there's no decision model anymore.
browser.decisionsFailed: The decision model didn't answer as expected ({error}). Check the endpoint and key.
browser.decisionsUntested: Couldn't test the decision model. Try again.
browser.ownDecisionsLine: Your organization's decision model also gets the goal of each browser step, the page's address, title, element names and first 1,500 characters, and the recent steps, earlier addresses included.
browser.ownDecisionsUnused: Your organization's decision model can't pick browser steps here yet. Until it can, the browser needs Jev on MindsHub.
